# Miles Purvis

> Software engineer based in Waterloo, Ontario. Currently at Vidyard, building and scaling core features for web applications and backend services.

## Work

- Software Engineer, Vidyard (present): building and scaling core features for web applications and backend services.

## Previously

- Chef de Partie to Sous Chef, Michelin-starred and high-end kitchens across Canada and Europe (2017–2022).

## Projects

- [LapAnalysis](https://github.com/MilesPurvis/LapAnalysis) (2026): Rust app that downloads AiM motorsport data logger sessions over Wi-Fi and browses laps, GPS maps, channel charts and optimal segments offline.

## Research

- [English Accent Classifier](https://huggingface.co/MilesPurvis/english-accent-classifier) (2025): Wav2Vec2 model fine-tuned on Mozilla Common Voice 23.0 to classify six English accents.
